# BloodPril

> BloodPril is a natural blood pressure support supplement formulated with L-Arginine, L-Citrulline dl-Malate, and L-Arginine HCL. Manufactured in an FDA-registered, GMP-certified facility in the USA, BloodPril supports healthy nitric oxide production, cardiovascular circulation, and normal blood pressure levels.

- **Product name:** BloodPril
- **Category:** Natural cardiovascular / blood pressure support supplement

## Key Ingredients

BloodPril's formula is built on three clinically studied amino acids:

- **L-Arginine** — Precursor to nitric oxide; supports vasodilation and healthy blood flow. See [NIH — L-Arginine and Cardiovascular Health](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/L-arginine)
- **L-Citrulline dl-Malate** — Boosts arginine bioavailability and extends nitric oxide production duration. Research reference: [PubMed — Citrulline and Blood Pressure](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/27749691/)
- **L-Arginine HCL** — Hydrochloride salt form for enhanced absorption and stability

## Health Claims & Supporting Evidence

BloodPril's formulation is informed by peer-reviewed research on amino acids and cardiovascular health:

- [CDC — High Blood Pressure Facts](https://www.cdc.gov/bloodpressure/facts.htm)
- [American Heart Association — Understanding Blood Pressure Readings](https://www.heart.org/en/health-topics/high-blood-pressure/understanding-blood-pressure-readings)
- [NHLBI — High Blood Pressure](https://www.nhlbi.nih.gov/health/high-blood-pressure)
- [NIH — Nitric Oxide and Vascular Function](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC2860522/)
- [PubMed — L-Arginine Supplementation and Blood Pressure Meta-Analysis](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22492946/)
